issues.claim: Building is cheap, translation is not. Creating nodes costs almost nothing, while translating the tree and hitting the source happen on every execution.
issues.problem: For EF Core, the main provider in this question, this is misleading. EF Core caches the compiled query by expression shape. Repeated executions of the same shape skip the full LINQ-to-SQL translation and only redo tree processing (parameter extraction, cache lookup) plus the database round trip. A senior candidate would learn that translation is repeated in full on every run. The same bullet also contradicts the claim in the same answer that captured values become SQL parameters read at run time, which is precisely what lets the cached query be reused.
issues.suggestedFix: Reword the bullet: building the tree is cheap, but each execution still walks the tree (EF Core extracts parameters and looks the shape up in its compiled-query cache), and the first run of a new shape pays full translation. In any case every execution pays the round trip to the source. If the result is needed several times, materialize it once. Mirror the change in RU: 'Построение дерева дёшево, но каждое выполнение всё равно обходит дерево и обращается к источнику; EF Core кэширует скомпилированный запрос по форме, поэтому полный перевод платится при первом выполнении новой формы.'

issues.problem: The pseudo-code inside the inline code span is translated in RU ('корень', 'лямбда1') but stays 'root', 'lambda1' in EN. This is the cause of the mechanical parity failure. The guide says code and identifiers stay in English in both locales.
issues.suggestedFix: Use `Select(Where(root, lambda1), lambda2)` in both locales.

issues.claim: kind: docs for the GitHub Queryable.cs source file
issues.problem: A source file in a repository is not documentation. The guide's allowed kinds contain no better fit than `article`, so this is only a labelling nuance.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally change kind to `article`, or keep `docs` if the team treats official repository sources as docs.
